The decisive mistake was Physics_Expert's first step (step 1). Its code searched "AI regulation" sorted by submitted date and filtered for "2022-06", which could only return the most recent papers, here from 2024. That left `june_2022_paper` undefined and caused the first failure. The same step also used a faulty filter for the 2016 article, comparing `published == "2016-08"` with a search for "Physics and Society". The agents never recovered from this wrong search strategy. Later steps fell back on placeholder IDs and manual instructions, and nobody found the actual papers or the correct word, "egalitarian".

AGENT: Physics_Expert
STEP: 1
